objective: Measure coverage without gaining it by including inapplicable items; no guaranteed positive result
primary: Exact applicable item set per case
oracle: Generated current states and explicit synthetic workflow rules; deterministic matching by patient and opaque rule code; no LLM judge
fairness: Same total available source packet and three-domain checklist; single initially sees full packet, candidate supervisor initially sees directory and workers initially see own-domain text and record fields; same seven raw tools across the system
candidate: Prompt-directed independent three-domain coverage review, fresh worker context and final supervisor synthesis; no oracle or mandatory correct-item union used by target
scope: Provided-document synthetic workflow auditing, not clinical accuracy or production RAG recall
dev: 4 breadth/subject/history scenarios before choosing final candidate
test: Fresh seeds and codes; freeze after dev; retain every execution
limits: Formal:24 logical model requests and24 raw tool executions;16384 output/reasoning tokens per request; worker240s; initial main600s; additional single reviews count toward time and shared request cap
inference: Paired by case; repeated cases cluster together, task items are not independent cases

development_amendments.reason: Initial 4096-token output+reasoning ceiling caused incomplete single responses; prompt-only candidate often did not delegate. Preserve all16 dev executions.
changes: All target requests now allow16384 output/reasoning tokens
Candidate supervisor sees directory, workers access actual scoped reference text and return it as evidence
Add single_audit: initial draft plus3 domain reviews in shared context plus final synthesis
Worker timeout240s, main600s, review calls count toward total time but use request timeouts

development_amendments.reason: Dev2 broad cases showed worker false inclusions and cross-patient swaps; candidate received unrelated record fields and earlier worker findings. One single-audit final emitted textual tool instructions.
changes: Workers get only own-domain record fields, retaining every patient/date/value in that domain; no prior worker answers
Supervisor encouraged to batch independent domain calls
Direct single review requests advertise same raw tool schemas with tool_choice=none because all sources already available
Scorer separates duplicate/format defects from semantic coverage; preserve legacy recorded scores in historical runs

development_amendments.reason: Provider returned native tool_calls despite tool_choice none during single audit; support actual tool execution instead of counting it as a semantic failure. Research worker confused missing-information tasks with waiting for user.
changes: Review uses full native tool continuation and same raw tools under common24-request cap
Common instruction for every arm explicitly clarifies that unknown-state clarification items are required deliverables

final_candidate: Directory-only supervisor; each worker receives its domain rule text and all patient/date fields in that domain, no previous worker answers; raw source returned as evidence; model synthesizes final set
primary_comparison: coverage_swarm versus single_audit over32 new input configurations:16 full five-arm cases and16 confirmation cases; unconditional second cohort
formal_scope: 32 generated state/order/code configurations from the same36-field simulated workflow catalog; not32 independent clinical scenarios
initial_dev_limits: 4096 used only in initial dev; all formal arms use16384
scoring: Exact item set is primary; macro coverage and precision both reported; duplicate formatting is separate from semantic omissions; no LLM judge
reporting: Do not call coverage gain overall quality gain if false inclusions worsen; report paired uncertainty and actual compute; all prior dev trials retained
review_protocol: Full native tool continuation for single reviews; same raw tools and common24-request/tool cap
data_audit: All32 expected sets independently rebuilt from displayed document rule text and latest dated notes, without using hidden structured states/rules
